left.raw_text: 1. OHCA: Every patient who suffered a cardiac arrest
that occurred in any location other than a hospital,

right.raw_text: and was attended and/or treated by an EMS.

left.raw_text: 2. IHCA: Every patient who suffered a cardiac arrest in hospital.

right.raw_text: 3. the representative population-based survey: Every patient who suffered a cardiac arrest in the selected cities or suburbs.
